notes: Answered strictly from public biography (Wikipedia, Biography.com, contemporaneous news coverage of the cancer/transplant/backdating stories) — no astrology content of any kind was consulted. Part D omitted entirely per instructions: those questions ask about chapters of an astrology reading, which this exercise forbade opening, so no answer exists for inst.v2.D1-D8. Genuinely undocumented/uncertain items, marked 'unknown' or given the most conservative code: A1-A3 (no reliably documented birth-time source, precision, or rectification claim is known to me, and I deliberately did not look for one, since that is exactly the astrological metadata this exercise forbids touching); A7-A9 (early childhood health, life-threatening danger before age 8, and grandparents' lifespans are not part of the standard public record). Two-parent complications, resolved by picking the more heavily documented relationship and flagging the other: A10/A11/A12/B6 mother/father entries use the adoptive parents Paul Jobs (1922-1993, close, steady machinist's income) and Clara Jobs (1924-1986, close) rather than birth parents Joanne Schieble/Abdulfattah Jandali, whom Jobs did not grow up with; C7/C9 reflect the same choice, at reduced confidence, because the biological-parent thread (reunion with birth mother, lifelong refusal to meet birth father) pulls the other way. A13/C-adjacent: sister relationships are genuinely split — adopted sister Patty Jobs was reportedly distant, while biological half-sister Mona Simpson (met in his late 20s) became extremely close and delivered his eulogy; 'close' was chosen on the strength of the Mona Simpson evidence. A28: four children total (Lisa Brennan-Jobs 1978, paternity initially contested/denied; Reed 1991, Erin 1995, Eve 1998 with Laurene Powell) but the A35 event cap only fits Lisa and Reed's births. A35/B6 dates are the well-documented ones (Apple founded April 1976, Apple IPO Dec 1980, ousted Sept 1985, Pixar acquired Feb 1986, married Laurene Powell 18 Mar 1991, cancer diagnosis Oct 2003, Whipple surgery Jul 2004 not listed for space, liver transplant Mar 2009, resigned as CEO Aug 2011 and died Oct 2011 also not listed for space — the 12-row cap forced dropping the surgery, resignation, and death itself even though all are firmly documented). A17/A19/C2: his outside partnerships (Wozniak, Sculley/the Apple board that fired him in 1985, later boardroom relationships) are documented as genuinely fraught alongside genuine success, hence 'opt2/real difficulty' for C2 despite his own ventures (C8) being an unambiguous success. A36 is not really answerable — Jobs died in October 2011, well before the mid-2023 reference window — 'same' was chosen only as the least presumptive placeholder among the offered codes, not as a real claim. C10 (ears/throat) has no documented history either way; answered opt1 at confidence 1 to signal 'no evidence, not a real claim.' A26 (early/late marriage by family pattern) has no documented family baseline, so 'on_time' is a low-confidence default rather than a sourced fact.
